import.noToken: Stopped: no KSeF token is saved.
import.ownerSaves: An owner saves one in Settings.
import.preparingPackage: KSeF is preparing a package of invoices; the next import picks it up.

rejected.title: KSeF import stopped: the token was rejected

registers.deactivatedDescription: They take no new entries. Their entries stay on the Income page, under their names.

dialog.nameDescription_one: Up to {{count}} character, different from your other registers.
dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from your other registers.

paymentMethods.noneActive: No active payment methods. Add or reactivate one before entering income.

confirmDelete.description: No entry uses it, so nothing else changes. You can add it again later.

error.nameTaken: A payment method named “{{name}}” already exists.

dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from your other payment methods.
dialog.cashDescription: The end-of-day close books the counted cash on this method. Only one active method can be cash.
dialog.cashTakenHint: “{{name}}” is marked as cash now. Remove its mark first to mark this one.

categories.description: What you buy is grouped in categories, as deep as you need, such as Alcohol › Whisky. Products go into them.

confirmDelete.description: A category can be deleted only while it has no subcategories and no products. This cannot be undone.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameDescription_one: Up to {{count}} character, different from the other categories in the same place.
dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from the other categories in the same place.
dialog.parentDescription: Pick a category to add a subcategory to it.
dialog.parentMoveDescription: It and its subcategories move together. A category cannot go under itself or its own subcategories.

analysis.title: Purchase analysis
analysis.description: What you buy, how much it costs and how prices change, from your purchase invoices.

notAssigned.name: Not assigned
notAssigned.hint: Bought, but not yet linked to a product. They count in the total.

leftOut.title: Not counted in these figures
leftOut.otherCurrency_one: {{count}} item on an invoice in another currency
leftOut.otherCurrency_other: {{count}} items on invoices in another currency
leftOut.withoutPackageSize_one: {{count}} item without a package size: in the spend, but not in quantities or prices
leftOut.withoutPackageSize_other: {{count}} items without a package size: in the spend, but not in quantities or prices

notFound.title: Product not found
notFound.description: It may have been merged into another product or deleted. Go back to the analysis to find it.

product.noUnit: No unit: counted in spend only

excluded.title: This product is excluded
excluded.description: It and its items are left out of every total, so it has no prices. Turn that off in its settings to count it again.

noUnit.title: This product has no unit
noUnit.description: Things like rent, electricity or deposits count in the spend only, with no quantity, price or price history.

chart.title: Price history
chart.description: Price, {{basis}}, by invoice issue date. Each point is a purchase.
chart.descriptionPer: Price per {{reference}}, {{basis}}, by invoice issue date. Each point is a purchase.
chart.none: No purchases with a price for {{period}}. Pick a longer period, or give the items below a package size.
chart.label: Price history chart. The same purchases are listed in the table below.
chart.withoutPrice_one: {{count}} purchase has no {{basis}} price, so it is not on the chart.
chart.withoutPrice_other: {{count}} purchases have no {{basis}} price, so they are not on the chart.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.description_one: {{count}} purchase with a price, newest first. Open the invoice to see everything on it.
purchases.description_other: {{count}} purchases with a price, newest first. Open the invoice to see everything on it.
purchases.none: No purchases with a price in this period.

items.title: Other items
items.description: Bought in this period and counted in the spend, but in no price: a correction, no package size, another currency.
items.none: Every item on this page is in the prices above.

item.title: Move or correct this item
item.packageSizeDescription: In the product's unit per one unit of the quantity: 0.7 for a 0.7 L bottle. Leave it empty if unknown.
item.menu: Move or set the package size…

merge.title: Merge {{name}} into another product
merge.description: Pick the product that keeps everything. The items of {{name}} move to it and {{name}} is deleted.
merge.confirmDescription: All the items of {{from}} move to {{into}}, and {{from}} is deleted. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Product settings
settings.description: Rename it, put it in a category, and choose what its prices are compared per.
settings.name: Name
settings.categoryDescription: Every item of this product follows it.
settings.measureDescription: Prices are compared per the same quantity whatever the package size.
settings.measureNoneDescription: For what is not goods, such as rent, electricity or deposits: it counts in the spend, with no prices.
settings.referenceDescription: Beer per 0.5, coffee per 1. Left empty, it is 1.
settings.excludedDescription: The product and all its items are not counted anywhere in the analysis.
settings.mergeDescription: For the same thing printed under two names. Its items move to the other product.

packageSizes.title: The same package size on the other items?
packageSizes.description: {{name}}: you set the package size to {{size}}. Sizes are not assumed equal across units, so nothing else changes unless you choose it here.
packageSizes.sizeDescription: In the product's unit per one unit of the quantity. A case or carton holds several pieces: type the size of the whole unit.

fill.title: Without a package size
fill.description: These items are not counted in the price analysis.

sameUnit.title: Same unit, another size
sameUnit.description: Items on the unit you just changed that still have a different size.

otherUnits.title: Other units, another size
otherUnits.description: Items on other units that have a size of their own.

packageSizes.toast_one: Package size set on {{count}} more item
packageSizes.toast_other: Package size set on {{count}} more items

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Items from your purchase invoices that have no product yet. Link them to products so they appear in the analysis, with prices.
review.empty: Nothing to review: every item has a product.
review.noMatch: No waiting item has “{{search}}” in its name.

error.title: Could not load the review queue

assign.loadFailed: The products could not be loaded.
assign.excludedOnly: Only excluded products are listed. To exclude something for the first time, create an excluded product.
assign.name: Product name
assign.nameDescription: Prefilled with the printed name: rename it to what you call the product.
assign.packageSizeDescription: In the product's unit, per one unit of the quantity on the invoice: 0.7 for a 0.7 L bottle, also when 6 were bought. Every item gets it; leave empty to keep each item's own. An item without one counts in spend, but not in prices.
assign.tooMany: At most {{max}} items can be assigned at once. Select fewer.
assign.createdKept: The product “{{name}}” was created. Try again to assign the items to it.

matching.title: Matching
matching.waiting_one: {{count}} item has no product yet and can be matched.
matching.waiting_other: {{count}} items have no product yet and can be matched.
matching.neverRun: The model has not gone through any items yet.

interrupted.title: The last run did not finish
interrupted.description: The run started {{when}} never reported back, most likely because the server restarted. Match again to continue.

unavailable.title: The model was unavailable at the last run
unavailable.description_one: The run stopped {{when}} because the model could not answer. {{count}} item went through before that; the rest are still waiting. Try again later.
unavailable.description_other: The run stopped {{when}} because the model could not answer. {{count}} items went through before that; the rest are still waiting. Try again later.

off.title: The model is switched off
off.description: This server has no key for the model, so items are matched only by the names and codes you confirmed before. Ask whoever runs the server to switch it on.

counts.label: What the last run did
counts.none: No item went through the model.

error.title: Could not load the matching status

toast.queuedDescription: It runs in the background; the numbers here update when it ends.

proposals.title: Proposed products
proposals.description: Items that match nothing in your catalog. The model proposes a product for each group; nothing is created until you confirm it.
proposals.sameName: There is a product named “{{name}}” now: these items are most likely that product.
proposals.createDescription_one: The product is created and {{count}} item is added to it. Change what the model proposed first if needed.
proposals.createDescription_other: The product is created and {{count}} items are added to it. Change what the model proposed first if needed.
proposals.mergeDescription_one: {{count}} item becomes part of the product you pick, and its names are remembered for next time.
proposals.mergeDescription_other: {{count}} items become part of the product you pick, and their names are remembered for next time.

toast.dismissed: Dismissed “{{name}}”. The items stay in the queue.

proposals.empty: No proposed products. When matching finds items that fit nothing in your catalog, the model’s proposals appear here.

error.title: Could not load the proposed products

matchSource.name: your confirmed name
matchSource.proposed_name: the model, which proposed the name of an existing product

matchCaveat.aliases_conflict: your earlier confirmations of this item point to different products.
matchCaveat.proposed_name_only: the model proposed a new product with this name, and a product with that name exists.
matchCaveat.measure_mismatch: the item's text gives a size in another unit than the product has (litres for a product counted in kilograms, or the other way round).
matchCaveat.size_read_weakly: the package size comes only from a multipack in the name.
matchCaveat.size_disagrees: the size remembered or given by the model differs from the one in the name.
matchCaveat.size_unverified: the size sits on a unit that holds an unknown number of pieces (a case, a carton).
matchCaveat.price_outlier: the price per unit of measure is far from this product's usual price: check the package size.

change.missingShift: Enters a shift that was not clocked
change.both: Changes the clock-in and the clock-out

shiftRequests.description: People ask for a shift they forgot to clock, or for new times. Times in {{timeZone}}.
shiftRequests.cardDescription: Newest first. Approving gives the shift the requested times; the shift rules (no overlap, nothing in the future) are checked then.

empty.pending: No requests are waiting for a decision.
empty.all: Nobody has asked for a shift change yet.

dialog.approveMissing: The shift is entered for {{name}}, marked as entered by you.
dialog.approveNewTimes: The shift gets the requested times, marked as corrected by you.

dialog.stillPending: The request is still pending. Fix the other shift on the Time page, or reject the request.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Purchase invoices by issue date. Click one for its details.
expenses.descriptionKsef: Purchase invoices by issue date, imported from KSeF or entered by hand. Click one for its details.
expenses.noneMatching: No expenses match the filters in this period.

sheet.importedFrom: Imported from {{source}}: it cannot be changed.
sheet.noVat: The invoice has no VAT breakdown.
sheet.noDocumentManual: Entered by hand, without a document.
sheet.deleteDescription: {{amount}} leaves the period's totals. A deleted expense can't be restored; you can enter it again.

error.issueDate: Choose the date on the document.
error.currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, e.g. EUR.
error.negative: Only a correction has negative amounts.
error.vatTotal: Enter the VAT total. Enter 0 for a document without VAT.

expenseForm.addDescription: A receipt or an invoice that is not in KSeF, with the amounts as printed.
expenseForm.foreign: VAT is settled in {{currency}}: the breakdown asks for both.
expenseForm.totalsDescription: As printed. Net is gross minus VAT.

error.businessDate: Choose the day the daily report covers.
error.futureDate: The day can't be after today.
error.payments: Enter at least one amount. Enter 0 for a register that sold nothing.
error.vatAboveGross: The VAT can't be more than the gross amount.

income.title: Income
income.description: Each register's daily report, by the day it covers. Click an amount to correct it.

noRegister.title: Add a register first
noRegister.description: Income is entered per register, one daily report each. Add the tills with their own fiscal printer, then come back to enter what they took.

days.title: Days
days.none: No days to enter for {{period}} yet.
days.none_month: No days to enter in {{period}} yet.
days.allEntered: Every day so far has at least one entry.
days.missing_one: {{count}} day has no entry yet. An empty cell adds that register's day.

days.vatDiffers: The VAT breakdown differs from the payments by {{amount}}

vat.none: No entry has a VAT breakdown.

vat.grossLess: The VAT gross is {{amount}} less than the payments. Allowed: e.g. invoiced transfers aren't on the fiscal reports.

entry.deletedMeanwhile: That entry was deleted in the meantime. Try saving again.
entry.paymentsDescription: Gross amounts. Leave a method empty if it wasn't used; 0 is fine.
entry.vatBreakdownDescription: As printed on the register's daily report. You can also add it later.
entry.vatMore: The VAT breakdown is {{amount}} more than the payments. That's allowed, e.g. for a transfer that isn't on the fiscal report.
entry.vatLess: The VAT breakdown is {{amount}} less than the payments. That's allowed, e.g. for a transfer that isn't on the fiscal report.

entry.dateInClosedMonth: {{month}} is closed. An owner can reopen it to add entries.

kind.bookedOver: Payments booked from the end-of-day close of {{name}}

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Gross pay for a month from the ended shifts and each person's rate. Your accountant does the rest.
payroll.readyOwner: Review the paychecks, then approve. Approving locks the month's shifts and rates.
payroll.readyManager: Review the paychecks. An owner approves the run, which locks the month's shifts and rates.

noRun.thisMonth: This month isn't over. A draft now is a preview: it can be approved once the month has ended.
noRun.pastMonth: Generate a draft from the month's ended shifts and the rates, review it, then an owner approves it.

run.locked: The month's shifts and rates are locked.

toast.reopen: {{period}} reopened as a draft: its shifts are unlocked

confirm.approveDescription_other: {{amount}} gross in {{count}} paychecks. The month's shifts and rates are locked until the run is reopened.

confirm.deleteDescription: Its paychecks and adjustments are deleted. You can generate the month again.

paychecks.title: Paychecks
paychecks.draft: Click a person to see their shifts and adjustments.
paychecks.markEach: Mark each paycheck paid once the money has left.

lines.roundedLess: Pay for hours is rounded once from the exact time, so it is {{amount}} less than the sum of the shift amounts.

generate.regenerateDescription: Rebuilds the paychecks from the current shifts and rates. Adjustments stay.
generate.exact: Shifts are paid to the second.
generate.nearest: To the nearest rounds a half up.

paidBy.cash: Paid on {{date}} by cash, marked on {{marked}}.
paidBy.transfer: Paid on {{date}} by transfer, marked on {{marked}}.

toast.description: {{name}}: {{amount}} per hour. Regenerate drafts to use it.

language.description: Of the invitation e-mail, and the new person's language until they choose one. People who already have an account keep theirs.

error.alreadyMember: {{name}} ({{email}}) is already a member of this organization.
error.deactivatedMember: {{name}} ({{email}}) is a deactivated member. Show deactivated members and reactivate them instead.

time.title: Time tracking
time.description: Shifts by the day they started on. Times in {{timeZone}}.

totals.title: Totals per employee
totals.description: Time worked for {{period}}. An open shift counts once it is clocked out.
totals.description_month: Time worked in {{period}}. An open shift counts once it is clocked out.
totals.none: Nobody worked a shift in this period.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Newest first. Open shifts are highlighted; end a forgotten one with End shift.
shifts.longerThanMaxHint: Longer than the maximum shift length: maybe a forgotten clock-out.

shiftDialog.addDescription: A shift someone forgot to clock. It is marked as entered by you.
shiftDialog.editDescription: {{name}}, {{date}}. The shift keeps who changed it and when.
shiftDialog.endDescription: {{name}} is still clocked in. Enter the clock-out to end the shift, or leave it empty to keep it open.
shiftDialog.keepOpen: Leave empty to keep the shift open.
shiftDialog.nextDay: The next day: the clock-out is not after the clock-in.
shiftDialog.notePlaceholder: Optional, e.g. why the shift was entered or changed

delete.title: Delete this shift?
delete.description: {{name}}, {{date}}, {{start}}–{{end}} ({{duration}}). The shift is deleted for good: this cannot be undone.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.description: Used across all modules: invoices, payroll and reports.
settings.name: Business name
settings.taxIdDescription: Needed to fetch purchase invoices from KSeF.
settings.csvDescription: Pick what your spreadsheet expects, e.g. for the payroll export. Excel in Polish or German uses semicolons.

dayCloses.title: End-of-day closes
dayCloses.description: The cash counted at the end of each day, with what the storages were expected to hold. A close books the day's revenue entry.
dayCloses.shortageDescription: The storages hold less cash than expected: a mistake in the count, or cash taken out that nobody recorded. The cash line of the revenue entry is booked as 0.
dayCloses.unknownMethod: A payment method no longer offered

list.none: No day was closed in this period. Employees close the day in the time clock, or you can record a close here.

detail.title: Close of {{date}}
detail.bookedAsCash: Booked as cash in the revenue entry: {{amount}}.
detail.noNonCash: No non-cash payment method was active at the close.
detail.revenueEntryOf: Booked for {{register}}, with the cash and the non-cash payments.
detail.noRevenueEntry: No revenue entry is booked from this close. Correct the close and save it to book it again.

editor.dateHint: Any day up to today, after the last closed day.
editor.dateUpToToday: Pick a day up to today.
editor.registerHint: The register whose revenue entry the close books.
editor.countedHint: What stays in it after the close, every denomination. An empty field is zero.
editor.depositHint: Only what was put into it at the close. An empty field is zero.
editor.nonCashHint: The day's amount for each method, as the terminal or the report shows it. An empty field is zero.
editor.shortage: {{amount}} short: the close will be flagged, and its cash booked as 0.
editor.fixFields: Some fields hold something that is not a number of pieces or an amount. Fix them to save.

correct.title: Correct the close of {{date}}
correct.description: Change the counts, the deposits, the non-cash amounts or the register. The day doesn't change: to close another day, delete this close and record a new one.
correct.confirmIncome: The cash income goes from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{booked}} booked as cash).
correct.confirmDescription: The revenue entry booked from the close follows, and so does the next close of each counted storage.

delete.title: Delete the close of {{date}}?
delete.description: Its revenue entry is deleted too, with its VAT breakdown and note. The cash it counted then counts in the next close of each storage, which is computed again. This can't be undone.
delete.failed: The close could not be deleted

recordPage.title: Record an end-of-day close
recordPage.description: Count every counted storage, enter what went into each deposit storage and the day's non-cash amounts, as an employee would in the time clock.
recordPage.cannotClose: There is nothing to close yet: the organization needs an active cash storage, a denomination of its currency and an active register.

cashFlow.title: Cash flow
cashFlow.description: What each storage holds now, and every movement and close that changed it.

balances.title: Balances
balances.none: There are no cash storages yet: add one first.
balances.estimateHint: An estimate until the next close: the day's takings are counted then.
balances.negativeEstimate: Below zero: cash taken out since the last count, which the next close replaces.
balances.retiredHint: Still holds deactivated denominations ({{denominations}}). Take them out with an adjustment.

history.description: Movements and end-of-day closes, newest first, in the organization's time zone.
history.ofStorage: Movements and closes of “{{name}}”, newest first.

description.adjustment: Change from the bank, a bank run, an opening float: cash that comes into a storage or leaves it.
description.transfer: The same pieces leave one storage and go into another. It changes no income.
description.count: What a deposit storage holds, counted outside a close. It replaces the balance; the difference is shown as the discrepancy.

form.chooseTarget: Choose the storage the cash goes into
form.sameStorage: The cash must go into another storage.
form.deactivatedStorage: This storage is deactivated: cash can only be taken out of it.
form.countOnlyDeposit: Only deposit storages are audited: counted ones are counted at each close.
form.noDenominations: There are no active denominations. Add them in Denominations first.
form.fixPieces: Enter whole numbers of pieces, from 0 to 1,000,000.
form.noteTooLong_one: A note can have at most {{count}} character.
form.noteTooLong_other: A note can have at most {{count}} characters.
form.whenHint: In the organization's time zone ({{timeZone}}). Not later than now.
form.momentInvalid: Enter a date and a time.
form.momentSkipped: {{time}} doesn't exist on this day (the clocks go forward). Pick another time.
form.momentInFuture: This is later than now: pick an earlier time.

delete.label: Delete: {{title}}
delete.title: Delete this movement?
delete.closesUnknown: The closes after it could not be checked.
delete.changesClose_one: The close of {{dates}} is recalculated: its expected opening, its cash income and the cash booked in its revenue entry.
delete.changesClose_other: The closes of {{dates}} are recalculated: their expected openings, cash income and the cash booked in their revenue entries.

cashStorages.title: Cash storages
cashStorages.description: Where the cash is kept. Each one is part of every end-of-day close: counted, or taking deposits.
cashStorages.noneActive: No active storages. Add one before the first end-of-day close.
cashStorages.deactivatedDescription: They are not part of new closes. Past closes and movements keep them, under their names.

modeDescription.counted: At the close, every denomination in it is counted, and the count is its new balance (e.g. the cash box).
modeDescription.deposit: At the close, the employee enters only what they put in, without knowing the balance (e.g. a drop safe).

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.description: No close or movement refers to it, so nothing else changes. The name becomes free again.

error.nameTakenByDeactivated: A deactivated storage is already named “{{name}}”. Reactivate it, or pick another name.

dialog.editDescription: Past closes and movements show the new name.
dialog.addDescription: A cash box, a safe or another place cash is kept. It starts empty: record its opening float as an adjustment.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.modeChangeHint: The change applies from the next close.
dialog.nameDescription_one: Up to {{count}} character, different from your other storages.
dialog.nameDescription_other: Up to {{count}} characters, different from your other storages.

denominations.title: Denominations
denominations.description: The coins and notes in {{currency}} that end-of-day closes count.
denominations.noneActive: No active denominations in {{currency}}. Add the coins and notes you count.
denominations.deactivatedDescription: They are not counted any more. If a storage still holds some, take them out with an adjustment.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{value}}?
confirmDelete.description: No close or movement uses it, so nothing else changes. You can add it again later.

error.valueTakenByDeactivated: {{value}} is already on the list, deactivated. Reactivate it instead.
error.valueRequired: Enter a value greater than zero.

dialog.description: A coin or note in {{currency}}, the organization's currency.
dialog.valueDescription: The face value, e.g. 5 for a five.

dayCloseSettings.title: Close of day
dayCloseSettings.description: How an end-of-day close gets its business date.

modeDescription.day_end_time: The date follows from the day-end time below, and employees don't choose it.
modeDescription.employee_picks: Employees pick today or yesterday. The timeclock suggests the date from the day-end time below.

dayEndsAtDescription.day_end_time: A close before {{time}} belongs to the previous day: with 05:00, a close at 02:30 on Saturday is Friday's. From 00:00 to {{latest}}.
dayEndsAtDescription.employee_picks: A close before {{time}} suggests the previous day. From 00:00 to {{latest}}.

timeTrackingSettings.title: Time tracking
timeTrackingSettings.description: When a shift counts as a possibly forgotten clock-out.
timeTrackingSettings.maxShiftHoursDescription: A shift longer than this is flagged on the Time page. While it is open, the person and the owners and managers get one e-mail about it. Nothing ends the shift for them. From {{min}} to {{max}} hours.

invitationLink.title: Invitation link for {{name}}
invitationLink.explain: If the invitation e-mail doesn't arrive, create a link and send it to this person yourself, for example by text message. Creating it makes earlier invitation links stop working, including the e-mailed one.
invitationLink.label: Invitation link
invitationLink.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link: select it and copy it by hand
invitationLink.validFor_one: Works once, for {{count}} day. Creating a new link replaces this one.
invitationLink.validFor_other: Works once, for {{count}} days. Creating a new link replaces this one.
invitationLink.warning: Whoever opens this link sets the password for {{name}}, so send it to that person only.
